decided_findings.scenario: You open a Sentry issue for E202 (the SoundFont failed to load) to see whether it only happens in Safari. decided_findings.whats_wrong: §3.3 sets `httpHeaders: false`, and §3.1 groups headers with the IP address. In the browser SDK the only headers Sentry collects are User-Agent and Referer; neither carries the visitor's IP address. Sentry's server builds an issue's browser, system and device only from the event's User-Agent header, with no fallback (Relay source, read; not run against sentry.io). So every issue arrives without them — the first thing triage needs for an audio player. Meanwhile the session ping sends `navigator.userAgent` on every visit whatever `dataCollection` says, and §3.4 says the ping carries only the release, the environment and whether the visit ended in an unhandled error. Every error event also carries the visitor's locale and time zone (Sentry's default culture context), which §3.1 does not list (R25).

decided_findings.title: A player opened in a background tab reports a font failure that never happened
decided_findings.scenario: You Cmd-click Play on the home page, so the player opens in a background tab, and you keep reading for two minutes. At 60 seconds that hidden tab sends Sentry an unhandled E204, "the music font did not arrive within 60 seconds", although nothing failed: the owner gets a new-issue email and your visit counts against the health number. When you switch to the tab, the score draws within a moment.
decided_findings.whats_wrong: The E204 backstop (NotationSurface.tsx:125-130) raises "the music font did not arrive within 60 seconds" when no `renderFinished` arrives in 60 seconds; it does not watch the font. AlphaTab 1.8.4 starts its first render from an animation frame, and browsers run none in a hidden tab, while the timer keeps counting. The spec now sends E204 as an unhandled error, so a /play page opened in a background tab and left for a minute sends a false one: it lowers the health number, uses quota and emails the owner. Spike: with animation frames held back, the font downloaded but nothing rendered in 5 s while a 3 s timer fired; releasing them drew the score 31 ms later. (Headless Chromium keeps every page visible, so the hidden tab was emulated.)
evidence_quotes: the music font did not arrive within 60 seconds
release that ended without an unhandled error — is the interim front-end health number.
